scope: Pure private ordered replacement selector plus explicit current sorting reference/candidate kernel measurements. No Flow caller integration, ECS cache, public API, dependency, canonical fixture or threshold changes. New helper cfg(test) until separately reviewed caller integration.
algorithm: Find globally worst eligible holder once: timed,preemptible,remaining>0,Some(completion)>now; max tuple(priority_level,original_admission_sequence,id). If none, return before constructing/consuming waiter iterator.

Input iterator is already sorted by (priority_level,original_admission_sequence,id). Iterate lazily; if waiter priority >= worst priority returnNone (remaining sorted priorities cannot preempt). Otherwise skip can_preempt false, return first can_preempt true with worst holder ID. No waiter Vec/clone/sort. Worstcase O(H+W) time, O(1) extra memory. Do not claim all mixed-mode workloads are constant cost.

Proof: for any incoming priority, either global worst is not strictly worse (no holder eligible for that incoming), or it is the same maximum selected by existing select_victim. Existing sorted first-admissible waiter rule follows unchanged. Retain old sorting selector as independent reference for tests/historical measurements.
tests: Compare new sorted-iterator output with existing original sorting selector over deterministic grids including varied/tied/extreme priorities, different admissions/IDs, holder input permutations, incoming can_preempt false/true, zero remaining, due/equal/missing completion, untimed and nonpreemptible holders.

Lazy iterator probe/panic verifies no consumption when no eligible holders; priority cutoff stops after first equal/worse waiter; first eligible incoming tie tuple wins. Include no-waiters and all-nonpreempting sorted waiters.
No unstable-ID Ord/Eq or fabricated complexity oracle; counters are untimed independent iterator probes.
benchmark_steps: Append ordered helper rows for W10/1000/100000, H1/10/100 and five repeats. Modes matched, equal-priority no match, ineligible holders, all-nonpreempting waiters with eligible worse holders. Pre-sort fixture outside timer, sorted-input production contract explicit.

Timed batches include loop costs and report exact calls, elapsed ns, ns/call, verified expected pair. An untimed iterator probe records actually yielded waiter count; production timing has no counting instrumentation. Constants MAX_CALLS=1000000, MAX_CALIBRATION_ATTEMPTS=5, MIN_BATCH_NS=1000000. Initial calls = clamp(1000000 / max(1,H+yielded_waiters),1,MAX_CALLS). Run at most five calibration batches, doubling calls with saturation at MAX_CALLS; stop at MIN_BATCH_NS, cap, or no increase. Retain each attempt, calls and elapsed. Unresolved sub-millisecond batches are exploratory, with no precision claim.

Keep existing sorting selector rows labelled as the current production sorting reference because Flow still calls it. Label new candidate rows ordered_selector_kernel_not_flow_integrated. Compare only matched shapes/modes. Defer historical_sorting_reference relabelling until a separately reviewed Flow caller switch. Metadata states measurements exclude fixture creation/sorting/holder construction; no end-to-end speedup claim.
Do not modify production_select_victim semantics in this leaf; final caller integration must reconcile remaining production/historical benchmark labels.
